newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds little changed, seen rangebound.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds little changed, seen rangebound.

text.p: 1525 GMT - Austrian bonds barely budged on Wednesday and traders forecast the market would remained pinned in a narrow range short-term, given a lack of impulses from abroad.
September bund futures traded a paltry 100 lots. "Cash is just as quiet as futures," said a trader.
* Benchmark 10-year 6.25 percent up 20 bps at 98.70 to yield 6.42 percent (6.44) in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 98.51/61 to yield 6.44/43 percent.
* At the near end, five-year 5.25 percent bond maturing March 2001 up 15 bps at 100.60 to yield 5.35 percent (5.39) in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.52/62 to yield 5.37/35 percent.
* 10-year spread to German bunds steady at eight bps, five-year spread up two bps at 24 bps.
* September AGB future unchanged at 103.55 on volume of 100 contracts.
* Money market rates slightly lower with 3-month VIBOR at 3.350 and overnight money at 3.06/31.
